_meta.description: Phase 5.5 (s186, 2026-05-13) - per-champion combo_sequence overrides for the ds.burst (assassin) scorer. Default combo is Q-W-E-AA-R-AA which fires every active spell once plus 2 auto-attacks - accurate for ~half the canonical assassins but materially underestimates burst for champions whose combo includes shadow/reset/chain casts (Zed Q2 via shadow, Yone Q3 chain knockup, Akali R2 recast, Katarina W dagger reset). Without this registry, /rank-assassin scores Zed as if his shadow Q didn't double-fire - items like Eclipse + Youmuu's get under-credited because the engine sees one Q at rank-X instead of two. Keys are DDragon canonical ids (NOT display names - Khazix without apostrophe, Leblanc with lowercase b). Combos use the existing token vocabulary: AA / P / Q / W / E / R plus repeat variants Q2-R2 + Q3 for triple-cast chains (Yone Q3).
_meta.rationale: Items that scale per-cast (Eclipse 2-hit proc, Stormrazor energized AA, Duskblade unseen threat, Edge of Night spell-shield) are sensitive to combo step count. Items that scale per-stat (raw AD, lethality, %pen) are not. The override moves the score for the per-cast items without distorting the per-stat items - this is the right axis to override on. Combos that intentionally fire fewer spells (Pyke skips W since his W is a stealth-up out of combat) are honored: Pyke -> 4 tokens vs default 6.
